ablation_interpretation.limits: These are dataset-variant aggregate comparisons, not per-scene causal ablations. They cannot isolate whether loss strength, confidence gamma, roughness stabilization, or image compositing is the dominant cause for a particular scene.
ablation_interpretation.rough_only: Roughness-only loses the reflection-consistency benefit and does not reliably rescue test full-image quality. It is therefore not a sufficient quality-preserving substitute for RC.
ablation_interpretation.wo_conf: Removing confidence weighting worsens reflection consistency and full-image metrics relative to RC in both datasets, while reflective PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS are often preserved or improved in Shiny synthetic and partly in Glossy synthetic. This suggests confidence weighting is not the sole source of full-image quality loss, but it may affect reflective-region behavior.
ablation_interpretation.wo_ref: Removing reflection loss consistently worsens mean reflection consistency relative to RC. It does not reliably improve full-image PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS; reflective metrics sometimes preserve or improve, especially in Shiny synthetic, but Glossy synthetic full-image metrics degrade relative to RC.

correlations.interpretation: Pearson correlation over 14 scoped scenes between positive consistency gain and quality regression severity; descriptive only, not causal.

decision: CONDITIONAL GO: evidence-grounded diagnosis and concrete pilot plan; no claim upgrade until new paired experiments prove quality preservation.
exclusions: no metric definition, mask, split, image_key, or LPIPS setting changes

likely_root_causes.cause: reflection loss strength or schedule over-regularization
likely_root_causes.support: RC gains consistency in 14/14 train and 13/14 test pairs, but strict all-quality wins are much rarer. The large helmet consistency gain coexists with small test full SSIM/LPIPS regressions; luyu and cat show quality drops with consistency gains. Correlations between consistency-gain magnitude and quality-regression severity are weak, so over-regularization is plausible but not proven globally.
likely_root_causes.uncertainty: Existing results use only the current lambda/start/every/gamma setting, so strength and schedule are confounded.

likely_root_causes.support: wo_conf worsens consistency and full-image metrics relative to RC in aggregates, but reflective metrics are often preserved or improved relative to RC. Reflective LPIPS wins are only 4/14 train and 6/14 test, suggesting region-level behavior is less stable than full-image LPIPS.
likely_root_causes.uncertainty: The aggregate wo_conf evidence cannot identify scene-level mask-confidence failures.

likely_root_causes.support: train.py optimizes L1 + DSSIM reconstruction plus auxiliary RC and optional regularizers; LPIPS is evaluation-only. This can improve the reflection-consistency metric without directly optimizing LPIPS or all PSNR/SSIM surfaces.
likely_root_causes.uncertainty: Adding LPIPS loss could bias toward the metric and may trade off PSNR/SSIM unless validated separately.

likely_root_causes.support: Full-image LPIPS improves more often than reflective LPIPS. Coffee is the test consistency exception while full-image quality improves and reflective quality drops, a pattern consistent with reflective-region mismatch or view-dependent mask instability.
likely_root_causes.uncertainty: The current artifacts do not expose per-pixel masks/roughness stability over training, so this remains diagnostic rather than confirmed.

limitations: No new training or metric sweeps were launched for this diagnosis.
Shiny Blender Real remains excluded due to the existing OOM blocker.
Ablations are aggregate paired evidence, not enough to prove per-scene causality.
LPIPS/PSNR/SSIM are evaluated after training; current RC does not directly optimize them.
The quality-preserving plan is a hypothesis until new paired rc_qp_* pilots complete.
scope: FD-P2-lite / non-Shiny-Real quality tradeoff diagnosis from frozen final artifacts
